status: predeclared before candidate fitting and fresh asset disclosure
feature_design: Eight engineered warm-color geometry and relative-dark shape features; HSV-style saturation>=0.24, max-channel>32, r>=0.90g, r>b, g>b, 0.25<=(g-b)/(r-b)<=1.10. Local dark threshold0.64 times median warm luminance. No feature design updates after fitting begins.
augmentation: Balanced patch labels; real-bus cutout width44..59 (stress36..64), half of positive placements can be partially cropped. Two backgrounds sampled equally; mixed512/256 scene rasters.35% negative examples are exact empty CAPTCHA tiles. Whole-patch illumination: gain uniform0.60..1.25, gamma0.85..1.20, per-channel balance0.90..1.10. Stress gain0.40..1.35, gamma0.75..1.30, balance0.85..1.15 plus RGB Gaussian sigma2.

qnn.initialization: three seeded random runs, no inherited v2 weights
qnn.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation patch BCE, evaluated every100 steps and first step

logistic.selection: minimum validation patch BCE; training-only standardization; Newton/backtracking optimizer

scene_validation.ground_truth: any inserted target alpha>32 pixel in tile, evaluation only
scene_validation.budget: zero marked tiles across all144 empty validation scenes and <=1% of512 target validation scenes with any false tile mark
scene_validation.threshold_selection: among budget-feasible thresholds maximize complete-scene rate, then patch validation F1, then prefer lower threshold. If none feasible, minimize number of violated empty/false scenes, then maximize complete-scene rate and patch F1; flag budget_feasible=false and do not promote.

final_evaluation: Freeze extractor source, trainer, candidate weights/thresholds, renderer, scene protocol, and model hashes before requesting fresh asset locations. Score fresh street absence and128 seeded seen-cutout placements/background/grid; score independently photographed bus known-ROI and full-photo coarse bbox separately. Previously inspected Emeryville/Oines are diagnostic only. No fresh/diagnostic result changes this iteration's candidates.
promotion_gate: No automatic promotion. Requires budget, identical-pixel JS/Python parity, default-background absence/placement/boundary regression, fresh identity evaluation, and explicit root review. Artifacts remain readyForDemo:false.
